message: [DUNS Application] needs your input: Brief description of what TinyPM does (1-2 sentences)
[DUNS Application] needs your input: When did your business start? (Year is fine)
[DUNS Application] needs your input: How many employees does the business have (including yourself)?
[DUNS Application] needs your input: What is your title/role in the company?
[DUNS Application] needs your input: What is your business phone number?
[DUNS Application] needs your input: What is your business PHYSICAL address? (No P.O. boxes allowed)
[DUNS Application] needs your input: What is the EXACT legal name of your LLC? (Must match your state registration exactly)
[Horizon Farm Credit] needs your input: What loan amount are you looking for, and what will the funds be used for?
[Horizon Farm Credit] needs your input: Do you have a signed lease agreement with Don, or is it a verbal arrangement?
[Horizon Farm Credit] needs your input: What is your approximate annual revenue for 2023, 2024, and 2025?
